entities.name: East Slavic Tribal Unions

entities.summary: The Poliane (around Kyiv), Drevliane, Siverianie, Ulichi, and Tivertsi tribal unions settled the Dnieper, Desna, and Bug river basins. The founding of Kyiv (legendary founding by Kyi, Shchek, and Khoryv) and the emergence of the Varangian trade routes.
